info.name: model-failover e2e
info.description: End-to-end coverage for the model-failover gateway policy: multi-target-group dispatch, cross-cluster failover with per-attempt model rewrite, suspend-driven skip-ahead, unmatched-model passthrough, zero-fallback groups, registration-time validation (dangling upstreamDefinition references, model-failover+resilience.retry composition (union of retriable status codes), basePath-carrying aggregate-cluster members), and LlmProxy cross-provider dispatch via additionalProviders aliases.

request.description: Two independent target groups: gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini on primary/fallback-1, claude-3-5-sonnet/claude-3-haiku on anthropic-primary/anthropic-fallback-1.

body.raw:
apiVersion: gateway.api-platform.wso2.com/v1
kind: LlmProvider
metadata:
  name: model-failover-test
spec:
  displayName: Model Failover Test
  version: v1.0
  template: openai
  context: /model-failover-test/latest
  upstream:
    url: http://host.docker.internal:9711

    - name: primary

        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9711
    - name: fallback-1

        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9712
    - name: anthropic-primary
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9713
    - name: anthropic-fallback-1
      upstreams:
        - url: http://host.docker.internal:9714
  policies:
    - name: model-failover
      version: v0
      paths:
        - path: /chat/completions
          methods: [POST]
          params:
            targets:
              - model: gpt-4o
                upstreamDefinition: primary
                fallbacks:

            requestTimeout: 5s
            suspendDuration: 10s
  accessControl:
    mode: deny_all
    exceptions:
      - path: /chat/completions
        methods: [POST]

request.description: Both openai-alias and anthropic-alias resolve to the SAME loopback address, distinguished only by request path (BasePath). Envoy's aggregate-cluster retry can't vary the path per member, so a retry from openai-alias to anthropic-alias would silently land back on openai-alias while still relabeling the response as anthropic - confirmed live before this validator existed. Must be rejected with a clean 4xx, not persisted as a broken route.

Omitting it entirely means 'openai-alias' can never resolve, and must be caught by the same dangling-upstreamDefinition-reference validator used for LlmProvider.

  context: /mf-proxy-no-additional-test

item.name: 32 - LlmProxy: Registration-time rejection when a fallback-having group defaults to main
Reject: target has a fallback and defaults its own primary to main - an LlmProxy's main is ALSO loopback+path-based

request.description: targets[0] omits upstreamDefinition (defaults to main) and has a fallback pointing at anthropic-alias. An LlmProxy's own main upstream is ALWAYS loopback-routed with the provider's context baked into the URL - structurally identical to an additionalProviders alias's BasePath - so this must be rejected exactly like an explicit BasePath-carrying reference would be.
